remarks: This beautifully maintained townhouse blends comfort and convenience in a desirable Stamford location. The main level offers an open, airy layout with engineered hardwood floors, a bright dining area, and sliders leading to two private decks-perfect for indoor-outdoor living. A half bath and generous closet space complete the first floor. Upstairs features brand-new carpeting, a spacious primary bedroom with a walk-in closet, a second bedroom with two closets, and a well-kept full bath. The laundry is conveniently located on the upper level. Additional storage includes both a crawl space and a pull-down attic. Freshly painted throughout and with a new hot water heater, this home sits in a well-cared-for community with low HOA fees that include water and sewer. Enjoy tranquil surroundings just moments from I-95, downtown Stamford, the train station, and Chelsea Piers-with New York City less than an hour away by train. HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS DUE 10/19 AT 8PM
